data.narrative:
Terrahaptix, a seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Nathan Nwachukwu and Maxwell Maduka, has raised $52M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 5 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies spanning both seed and Series A stages, with the broader Defense & Security frontier-tech universe including 10 private and 2 public comparable companies.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $52M total raised as a value proxy, applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage progression, yielding $130M. Peer-median analysis across the 5-company comp set—which includes UFORCE ($1.0B seed-stage), Stark Defence ($4.0B Series A), Castelion and Singularity (both $1.0B and $400M Series A respectively), and NODA AI ($125M Series A)—produces a median valuation of $1.0B, with a range of $125M to $4.0B.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $110M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $565M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around stage-specific risk, relative product maturity, and customer traction versus peer benchmarks. Key uncertainties include revenue trajectory and defensibility of technology within a capital-intensive, high-barrier defense sector. The peer-median approach carries elevated weight given stage and sector alignment, though the stage-progression method provides a more conservative floor.
